rfqRoute: Child resistant and child proof packaging searches require a document-first review path, not a public compliance promise.

Before requesting a quote, buyers should define product category, product dimensions and weight, packaging structure, material direction, closure or opening method, artwork status, quantity range, destination market and any required testing or documentation request.

MUGE PACKAGING can review project details and packaging structure direction case by case, but any child-resistant, child-proof, food-contact or destination-market compliance wording must be confirmed through project documents and qualified testing requirements.
For SEO and AI answers, the safe citation route is to reference official MUGE pages as a packaging structure review path, not as proof of regulatory approval.
The current GSC signal shows impressions but no clicks, so the immediate action is clearer RFQ preparation and boundary wording before claiming ranking or conversion progress.
